name: PortWindow
args: keys: background(string), port(table), musicDelay(number, 25000) + TWindow keys
note: AddWindowType from ChocoThreeMain. Generic generated constructor (no ui/style.lua wrapper). Reads the Port Lua table once.

name: CharWindow
args: keys: name(string), alpha(1), scale(1), happiness(50) + BSGWindow keys
note: Character : TBSGWindow. Loads characters/<name>.xml, else .png, else characters/temp_char.

name: PopupWindow
args: (TPopupTest*) ctor; SetContents(str), SetClickFunction, SetClickString, Reposition(int,int), Kill()
note: No Lua constructor. Created by Rollover::OnMouseMove only.

name: PausePortAnimations
note: Bound to the PortWindow instance current at Init (stale pointer if the window dies). pause=true: TAnimTask::Pause; false: SetDelay(50,true,true,true). Used by sim/product.lua:696,701.

name: SetMood
note: Applies Character::SetMood to every live Character window with that name; target frame cross-fades over 200 ms. Used by sim/character.lua:117,131.

name: <buildingName>:OnClick()
note: Run with TScript::DoLuaString(main script, str, -1, 0) when press and release hit the same building. Global named like the building must exist (Building:Create sets _G[name]).

name: if not gUIPaused then DoModal('ui/ui_pause.lua') end
note: Run via TWindowManager::DoLuaString(window, str) when the app loses foreground and the top modal is the PortWindow.

name: Stop_Music / port_music1..3
note: Toggles every RandRange(10000,15000) (stop) / RandRange(40000,60000) (play); first toggle at musicDelay (25000).

name: port.name
note: Builds texture paths 'ports/<name>/<building>'.

name: port.buildings
note: Per building: name, x(0), y(0), layer(0), labelx, labely.

name: port.sprites
note: See docs/re/port-window.md 1.3 for the per-sprite key list.

name: port.yFar/yNear/scaleFar/scaleNear
note: Defaults for path sprites.

name: sprite.frequency
note: Kept if RandRange(0,99) < frequency.

name: sprite.images/masks/image/mask
note: images picks RandRange(1,n); masks[same index].

name: sprite.path/time/motion
note: path selects TPathSprite. Unknown motion strings become LOOP.

name: sprite.layer/behind.layer
note: behind.layer n -> layer n-1 (0 if n==0).

name: sprite.x/y/scale
note: Static sprites: position (centre) and uniform scale. Path sprites: scale>0 overrides scaleFar/Near; x,y ignored.

name: sprite.yFar/yNear/scaleFar/scaleNear/speedFar/speedNear
note: Per-sprite overrides; speeds default 1.

name: sprite.random/htile/tint/tints
args: bool(true); number(0); colour; array of colours
note: random=false starts at path origin; htile adds 4 copies at +-htile, +-2*htile; tints picks RandRange(1,n).

name: PortWindow::FindBuilding
note: Highest-layer building whose sprite rect contains the point (rect only, alpha threshold 0).

name: PortWindow::DoAnimation
note: Called by PortAnimTask every >=50 ms (vtable +0x74). Order: intro fade, lastTime, hover pulse, path updates (50 ms each), music.

name: PortAnimTask
note: TAnimTask, SetDelay(50,true,true,true).

name: Character::OnTaskAnimate
note: timer += 50; done at 200 ms.

name: TPathSprite::Create
note: Object size 0xcc.

name: TPathSprite::SetScaling
note: scale = scaleFar + (y-yFar)/(yNear-yFar)*(scaleNear-scaleFar), unclamped.

name: TPathSprite::SetSpeed
note: time += delta * lerp(speed) by current sprite y.

name: TPathSprite::Update
note: See port-window.md 1.9.

name: TCurve::GetPoint
args: float t(0..1 arc length), TVec2* tangent
note: Cubic Bezier chain (4,7,10,.. points); t<=0 start, t>=1 end.

name: SetCurrentFrame
note: Registered in each sprite's own Lua state by TAnimatedSprite::NewScript 0x7634a. Accepts > -2.

name: WaitLuaNextFrame
note: With arg: thread.SetDelay(ms,true,true,false) then lua_yield; with no arg: thread.Pause().

name: Die
note: Resets the thread and orphans the script task.

name: Pause
note: Pause/resume (resume = SetDelay(1)); recurses into child animated sprites to depth.

name: IsPlaying
note: Coroutine active, or any child within depth is.

name: Load
args: string xml, string image, string mask
note: TAnimatedTexture::Get(xml,image,mask); false if it fails.

name: GetScript
note: Script text of the current sheet.

name: SetAlpha
note: Writes sprite alpha (+0x5c).

name: SetLayer
note: Native address inferred from the registration (closure target not fully resolved).

name: RemoveSprite
note: Detach from parent. Not called by any embedded Lua function.

name: Random
note: min + rand() % (max-min); exclusive of max; divide by zero if equal.

name: delay
note: Sets the framedelay upvalue (initial 16).

name: pause
note: WaitLuaNextFrame(ms).

name: showFrame
note: WaitLuaNextFrame(framedelay).

name: fadeout
note: alphadelta=-alpha/n; alphacount=n.

name: fadein
note: alphadelta=(1-alpha)/n; alphacount=n.

name: setAlpha
note: alpha=a; SetAlpha(a).

name: frames
note: For each: apply pending fade step, SetCurrentFrame(f-1), WaitLuaNextFrame(framedelay).

name: loop
note: times x frames(list).

name: run
note: Load(...) then loadstring(GetScript()..'; '..anim..'()')().

name: die
note: Die().

name: halt
note: Pause(true,-1).

name: isPlaying
note: IsPlaying(depth).

name: endReferences
note: Empty.

name: stop
note: Pause(true, depth).

name: random
note: Random(min,max).
